solutionContexts.label: Heat ODPA MSCs with indium myristate and myristic acid · formulation context
solutionContexts.scope: ODPA-terminated InP MSCs: mass 100 mg; Indium myristate: amount 0.4 mmol; Myristic acid: amount 0.25 mmol, purity ≥99 %; final temperature: 370 degC. Heat up to 370 °C;100 °C spectrum narrows,200/300 °C molecular species appear with identities unassigned. On reaching 370 °C those species disappear and QDs grow overonehour. Injection temperature, solvent volume and ramp rate are unreported. Independent component references do not assert solution speciation or intercomponent geometry.
